summary: Colombia's Ministry of Justice and Law confirmed on 3 August 2026 that a ransomware attack had compromised part of its technology infrastructure, degrading several digital services days before the presidential transition. The ministry said it detected the attack, isolated the affected systems, and was working with MinTIC to restore services. It refused to negotiate with the attackers and asked the Attorney General's Office and National Police to investigate. No group was named and no data theft was reported.
